H4609: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H2492: properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream
H227: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H7440: properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H7622: exile, concretely, prisoners; figuratively, a former state of prosperity
H650: properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of astream; also a strong thing or a hero
H5045: the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine)
H2232: to sow; figuratively, to disseminate, plant, fructify
H7114: to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain)
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H2233: seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
